zh: 一个方案完全由 a 人队的数量 x 决定：剩下的 p − a·x 人必须恰好分成若干个 b 人队。
枚举 x 从 0 到 p/a，若剩余人数能被 b 整除就得到一个合法方案，队数为 x 加上剩余人数除以 b，在所有方案中取最小。
把最优值初始化为不可能达到的 p+1；对每个 x 计算剩余人数 rest，rest 能被 b 整除时用 x + rest/b 更新；枚举结束后若仍为 p+1 则输出 −1。
en: A plan is fully determined by the number x of a-person teams: the remaining p − a·x people must split exactly into b-person teams.
Enumerate x from 0 to p/a; whenever the remaining people are divisible by b, you get a valid plan with x plus remaining/b teams. Take the minimum over all plans.
Initialize the best value to the impossible p+1; for each x compute rest = p − a·x and, if b divides rest, update with x + rest/b; if the best is still p+1 at the end, print −1.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Enumerate the number of a-person teams; if the remaining people are divisible by b, that forms a valid plan. Take the plan with the fewest teams.

## Proof of correctness

The number of a-person teams in any valid plan must lie within the enumerated range; once it is fixed, the number of b-person teams is uniquely determined by the remaining people, and the divisibility check is a necessary and sufficient condition for validity. Taking the minimum over all valid plans gives the optimum; if there is no candidate, there is no solution.

## Complexity

O(p/a+1) time and O(1) extra space.
